column1: The following rates shall be applicable notwithstanding the rates

column2: specified in the First, Second and Third Schedules.
Rate of income tax on the total amount of interest
on compensation payable in respect of property
vested  in  the  Government,  the  Land  Reform
Commission  or  a  public  corporation  or  a  local
authority (section 36)
Rate of income tax on the total amount of interest
received from any bank deposit (section 37)
Rate of income tax on the gross interest on loans
granted by a company, partnership or other body
or persons outside Sri Lanka (section 38)
Rate  of  income  tax  on  royalty  payable  to  any
company,  partnership  or  other  body  or  persons
outside Sri Lanka (section 39)
The rate of income tax on profits and income from
off-shore  foreign  currency  transaction  of  any
foreign currency banking unit (section 41)
The  rate  of  income  tax  on  profits  and  income
arising  to  any  consignor  or  consignee  from
entrepot trade involving precious stones, metals
not mined in Sri Lanka  or any petroleum , gas or
petroleum  products  or  such  other  approved
products (section 42)
The  rate  of  income  tax  on  profits  and  income
arising  to  any  person  from  any  approved
undertaking  for  the  operation  and  maintenance

of  facilities  for 
the  storage  of  goods  or
commodities involving entrepot trade (section 43)
The rate of income tax applicable to any profits
or gains on the disposal of company shares, rights
or warrants (section 44)
The  rate  of  income  tax  on  profits  from  an
undertaking carried on by a person other than a
company, and engaged in agriculture, promotion
of  tourism  or  construction  work  as  defined  in
section217 and section 45 (section 45)
